query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as total_dias,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as total_realizado_sem_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(*), 2) as media_diaria_todos_dias,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) + (SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(*) * 3), 2) as projecao_final
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
